experiences.title: Data Engineering Intern
experiences.problem: No reliable way to migrate legacy survey and user data into a modern database. Datasets were inconsistent, PII was stored in plaintext, and there was no automated migration process in place.
experiences.solution: Built a full ETL pipeline to migrate 1,200+ user profiles and survey responses into new platform, with automated validation, schema mapping, deduplication, and an encryption module for sensitive PII fields.
experiences.impact: Zero data loss, preserved the organization's full survey history, eliminated manual migration work, and hardened data security.

experiences.title: Data Engineer
experiences.problem: Construction teams relied on physical binders and documents to find project information which slowed down their workflow. Needed a reliable, document-grounded AI system that could answer project questions more accurately than a general-purpose tool like ChatGPT
experiences.solution: Architected and built a RAG pipeline, designing the parsing, and chunking stages that turned raw construction documents into a reliable, queryable knowledge base. Automated metadata extraction, rollback on document upload failure, and stale embedding cleanup.
experiences.impact: Delivered a RAG pipeline handling 100+ page documents end-to-end. Reduced vector store noise by 50%. Made document uploads failure-safe. Increased document retrieval relevance by 25%

experiences.title: Apriori & MinHash Optimization
experiences.problem: Standard Apriori had unsustainable memory costs at scale, and traditional MinHash produced similarity matches driven by generic words rather than semantically meaningful ones.
experiences.solution: Re-implemented Apriori using a Trie data structure to reduce memory usage, and built a Weighted MinHash algorithm that biased similarity scoring toward sentiment-rich tokens using ratings and recommendation flags.
experiences.impact: 35% reduction in memory usage over baseline Apriori. Weighted MinHash retrieved more semantically relevant matches across 250 pairwise comparisons.

experiences.title: AI Engineer Intern
experiences.problem: Needed to know whether open-source LLMs could reliably extract PHI from medical records, but had no benchmarking framework and no efficient way to run evaluations on constrained hardware.
experiences.solution: Built a prompt engineering and evaluation framework to benchmark LLMs against clinical text, converted XML medical records into plain text for NLP testing, and automated batch execution loops for overnight processing.
experiences.impact: Automated overnight batch runs eliminated the hardware bottleneck and increased evaluation throughput by 25%.
